commands.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=d4f9ef9b4a4cb1f55c50e6353e37d35b6ebbdf35; git fetch origin main; git checkout main; git reset --hard origin/main; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; PORT=$(python3 -c 'import socket; s=socket.socket(); s.bind(("127.0.0.1",0)); print(s.getsockname()[1]); s.close()'); TMP=$(mktemp -d); python3 -m http.server "$PORT" --bind 127.0.0.1 >"$TMP/http.out" 2>"$TMP/http.err" & HTTP_PID=$!; CF_PID=''; cleanup(){ if [ -n "$CF_PID" ]; then kill "$CF_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$CF_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; kill "$HTTP_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$HTTP_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf "$TMP"; }; trap cleanup EXIT; run_probe(){ PROTOCOL="$1"; : >"$TMP/cf.err"; if [ "$PROTOCOL" = auto ]; then cloudflared tunnel --url "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT" --no-autoupdate >"$TMP/cf.out" 2>"$TMP/cf.err" & else cloudflared tunnel --protocol "$PROTOCOL" --url "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT" --no-autoupdate >"$TMP/cf.out" 2>"$TMP/cf.err" & fi; CF_PID=$!; URL=''; for i in $(seq 1 80); do URL=$(grep -Eo 'https://[a-z0-9-]+\.trycloudflare\.com' "$TMP/cf.err" | head -n1 || true); [ -n "$URL" ] && break; sleep 0.25; done; echo protocol=$PROTOCOL; echo url_published=$([ -n "$URL" ] && echo true || echo false); if [ -n "$URL" ]; then HOST=$(printf '%s' "$URL" | sed 's#https://##'); echo host=$HOST; if command -v dig >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo system_dns=$(dig +short "$HOST" | paste -sd, -); echo cf_dns=$(dig @1.1.1.1 +short "$HOST" | paste -sd, -); fi; CODE=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 8 "$URL/" 2>"$TMP/curl.err" || true); echo curl_code=$CODE; sed -n '1,3p' "$TMP/curl.err" | sed 's/^/curl_err=/' || true; fi; grep -E 'Registered tunnel connection|Failed to serve tunnel connection|Unable to establish connection|quic|http2|ERR|error' "$TMP/cf.err" | tail -n 15 | sed 's/^/cloudflared=/' || true; kill "$CF_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$CF_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; CF_PID=''; }; run_probe auto; run_probe http2; cleanup; trap - EXIT; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo cloudflared_transport_diagnostic_complete=true
